paired_array_definition: Mean,lower,upper95percent marginal paired system-bootstrap interval;not adjusted for multiplicity.Seeds are separate fits of the same48-system panel,not independent new systems.

seed72_A_bond_horizon.interpretation: Distant-query geometry degradation repeats in both A seeds.A72/B72 terminal-frame bondRMSEs are close despite better pooled-window A geometry.This is joint-window generation,not autoregressive error accumulation;not proof that the time-feature MLP alone causes failure.

seed72_temporal_order.interpretation: A72 mean lag1 approaches MD,but lag4 is too positive;B72 under-orders lag1 whereas B71 over-orders it.Time-dependent drift/amplitude can raise ordering in damaged windows.These descriptive values do not establish correct kinetics or robust recipe superiority.

seed72_amplitude_bins.interpretation: A high-motion RMSF suppression repeats.B high-motion ratio changes from1.198(seed71) to0.730(seed72);neither stable larger-motion preservation nor inherent local-only generation is established.B72 improves MSD in all bins but worsens bonds in all;RMSF clearly improves only in medium bin.

seed72_full_path_scores.coverage: All48 systems/96 conditions/192 draws per model;0 additional model calls
seed72_full_path_scores.interpretation: A improves all four CA path scores over h/v in both seeds;this positive motion-distribution evidence is retained despite worsened all-atom geometry.B72 also improves all four versus h/v,but B71 did not.A/B72 differences are unresolved on all four;do not interpret B72 MSD advantage as blanket path superiority.Versus BioKinema,A position paths are worse and pair-distance-increment paths better in both seeds;remaining two unresolved.B72 has the same pattern.Two-draw fair scores do not establish correct all-atom joint dynamics or thermodynamics.

cross_seed_findings: A improves RMSF/MSD errors versus h/v in both seeds at1ns,but worsens bond/clash/torsion-increment errors in both.No simultaneous geometry-motion victory at this extrapolated grid.

A beats B on geometry/torsion-increment errors in both seeds,while MSD ranking reverses:B worse in71,better in72.B-vs-A RMSF advantage is unresolved in72,not evidence that B wins every motion measure.

Both recipes remain worse than released BioKinema on geometry/MSD/torsion-increment errors.BioKinema H1+MSA and46/48 known training overlap remain important fairness limitations;do not claim an unbiased unseen-system ranking.
No static pretraining in these runs.No clipping,source modification,query-time remapping or postprocessing used to repair1ns results.All systems/seeds retained.
